translation.name: Iwaperite tajorentsi ikenkithatakoetziri awinkatharite Jesokirishito: owakirari inimotakiri tajorentsi

content: Kyaaryo iroka ikanteetziri: “Aririka ikowaki shirampari reewatakagaeyerini iyemijantzinkarite, tema okameethatzi iroka ikowakiri”.

Aririka iiteetziri amitakoeyeririni iyemijantzinkarite, tee okameethatzi ojeeke rantani. Kameetha raye iina apaani, tee okameethatzi ishinkitya, kameetha ikenkithashiryaanakya, ikameethashirete, kameetha ineshironkatawakiri areetyaarini, kameetha riyotaperote riyotaante.
Tee okameethatzi rirapiintero kepishaaperotatsiri, tee okameethatzi ikijya; omaanta kameetha ikaminthaante, kameetha ijeeki, tee okameethatzi ikowaperoteri koriki.
Kameetha riyotaapiintero iina, kameetha riyotaapiinteeyerini reentsitepaeni raapatziyanteeyaririni irirapaeni, eerokya ipiyathateeyantaririni, kameetha ijeekanteeyarini.
Eerorika imatziro raapatziyakayaari reentsitepaeni, eejatzi iina: ¿tsika ikantyaaka riyotaantyaari maawaeni riraga aapatziyeeyaririni Tajorentsi?
Tee okameethatzi reewatakaante owakira aapatziyariri Jesoshi: aririka ikantakaaperotakya. Ikimitarikari iwinkatharite kamaari, ikantakaaperotaka paerani, rootaki roepiyantaariri jaawiki Tajorentsi.

Kameetha riyoteeyerini riraga kaari aapatziyeeyaririni, ikanteeyeni: “Ikameethatzi riraga jewatakagaeyiririni aapatziyariri Jesoshi”. Rootaki eero imatantari ikantzimateeyerini, eejatzi eero imatantari kamaari rantakayeri kaari kameethatatsi.

Riraga amitakotapiintziriri iyemijantzinkarite: kameetha roshiyari riraga jewawentziriri iyemijantzinkarite, ikameethashiryaanaki. Tee okameethatzi ramatawitante. Eejatzi tee okameethatzi rirero osheki pyaarentsi. Eejatzi tee okameethatzi ikenkithashireeri koriki raapithatashitakari paashini atziri.
Kameetha ikyaaryoowentero ikemijantaperotero maawaeni riyotaayitziririni Tajorentsi, eejatzi okameethatzi riyote tekatsi rantani.
Pityaawo paminaperoteri, piyotaperoteri ikameethataperotzirika. Aririka piyoteeyakini ikameethataperotzi, ari pikanteri ramitakoeyerini maawaeni aapatziyariri Jesoshi.
Eejatzi okimityaari iina, okameethashiretanaki: okenkithashiryaa kameetha, tee okameethatzi okantzimatante, tee okameethatzi oshinkitya, tee okameethatzi amatawitante.

Riraga amitakotantatsiri iyemijantzinkarite, kameetha raye iina apaani. Kameetha riyote raapatziyakaaperotyaari itomipaeni: iñaaperoteri irirapaeni iriri. Eejatzi kameetha riyote raapatziyakagaeyaarini maawaeni jeekimoteeyiririni.
Aririka kameetha ramitakoeyerini iyemijantzinkarite, ari iñaaperoeteri, eejatzi imatero ikenkithatakoperoteri Jesokirishito, eero ithaayi. Tema riyotzi kameetha raapatziyari irira.

Nokowawitaka intsipaete nareetzitapaemimi, omaanta eerorika nomatziro. Rootaki nojankinatantzimirori iroka: nokowaki piyote tsika akanteeyakani. Riyoyagaeyakaeni Tajorentsi: tema aakateeyakini aapatziyeeyaririni. Añaatsiri. Ayoteeyironi iroka kyaaryootaperotatsiri: kameetha akyaaryoowentero owaagayiteroni.

Kyaaryo, tee ayotashita tsika ikantari Tajorentsi, omaanta riyotakagaeyakaeni Jesokirishito. Irira rirotaki Tajorentsi, omaanta ratziritapaaki. Rowaga Ishire, rootaki iyotakagaeyeerini itajorentsitaki. Riraga ronampiripaeni Tajorentsi raminakowenteeyakirini Jesokirishito. Akamantakoeyakirini aari mawaeni kipatsikipaeni, raapatziyanteeyakaririni jeekatsiripaeni. Roenokaeri Iriri eejatzi jenokinta, kameetha ijeekapaekya.
